program_name: Canada Digital Adoption Program Boost Your Business Technology
funder: Innovation Science and Economic Development Canada
amount_notes: Up to $15,000 non-repayable grant plus access to 0% interest BDC loan up to $100,000. Grant portion only is non-repayable.
organization_types_eligible: Canadian for-profit businesses with 1 or more employee
eligibility_criteria: Must be a Canadian for-profit business
Must have at least 1 paid employee
Must have minimum $500,000 in annual revenue
Must adopt new digital technologies to improve operations
Must work with a registered CDAP digital advisor
exclusions: CRITICAL: For-profit businesses only — NFP not eligible
Businesses under $500,000 annual revenue not eligible
Pre-revenue and pre-launch businesses not eligible
notes: STATUS UNCERTAIN: CDAP announced as winding down in 2024 federal budget. Verify current program status before recommending. Not applicable to Emerge Academy NFP or pre-revenue OpsCo. Relevant for Sacral Solutions once revenue threshold met.
